parameters.query: INSERT INTO backup_registry (backup_type, file_path, file_size_bytes, status, tables_included, started_at, completed_at, retention_days, expires_at) VALUES ('{{ $json.backup_type }}', '{{ $json.filepath }}', {{ $json.file_size_bytes }}, '{{ $json.success ? 'completed' : 'failed' }}', ARRAY[{{ $json.tables.map(t => "'" + t + "'").join(',') }}], '{{ $json.started_at }}', '{{ $json.completed_at }}', {{ $json.retention_days }}, '{{ $json.expires_at }}')
DELETE FROM backup_registry WHERE expires_at < NOW() AND status = 'completed'
